title: Jev limitations
summary: Keep precision and enforceable rules outside semantic judgment.

sections.label: Documented weaknesses
items: Irrelevant large state and contradictory instructions.
Free-form generation is not its trained purpose.

sections.label: Design response
sections.text: Filter evidence, ask one explicit judgment at a time, allow missing information, and implement calculations/dates/invariants in code. Pin the evaluated model version.

sections.label: Acceptance
sections.text: Adverse cases are tested before expanding use. A confident answer cannot override structural, access, or publication rules.

sections.label: Gap review: workflow use and checks
items: Recommended use: Use documented weaknesses to choose diagnostic cases and enforce exact logic outside the model.
Pin the evaluated model and question version.
Include numeric, temporal, misleading-context and missing-information negative controls.
Workflow placement and checks are Atlas recommendations. Existing examples, tenant availability, older product claims and comparative benefits were not revalidated by this mapping review.

catalog.applicability: Use this Jev example when deciding what to keep outside semantic judgment, such as counting, date comparison, multi-hop questions or enforceable rules. Implement calculations, dates and invariants in code and test adverse cases before expanding use.
catalog.limits: Reading a topic does not configure tools, execute a workflow or establish passing evidence.
